compareDisposition.rationale: No distinct two-source pairing adds more than this passage and its existing Scripture connections.

observations.body: Jesus steps forward and speaks while Judas, soldiers, officers, lanterns, torches, and weapons fill the garden.
observations.label: Approach

observations.body: Simon Peter draws a sword, strikes the high priest’s servant, and cuts off his right ear; the servant is named Malchus.
observations.label: Strike

observations.body: Jesus commands Peter to sheath the sword and names the cup given by the Father.
observations.label: Answer

payload.posture: Keep Peter’s action, Malchus’s injury, Jesus’s command, and the cup saying within John’s narrated sequence.
payload.tension: Peter acts against the arresting group while Jesus answers the sword by accepting the cup before him.
payload.title: The sword drawn
